create_logger: create a logger with file and console handlers using create_logger with filepath and rank arguments
create_log_formatter: create a LogFormatter instance that tracks elapsed time since initialization
reset_logger_time: reset the elapsed time tracking on a logger created by create_logger
format_log_records: format log records with levelname, timestamp, and elapsed time using LogFormatter.format
create_multi_process_logger: create separate log files per process by passing different rank values to create_logger
